description: Real pytest issues fixed by small merged pull requests, selected by src/evo/evolve/select_tasks.py (criteria in its docstring). Held-out tasks are the newest, and every reflection/validation fix predates the earliest held-out snapshot. Held-out results are computed once per experiment and never shown to the optimizer.

tasks.title: Provide users a way to exit on error if exceeded the maximum configured warnings
Version short name (-V) does not appear to work
Exception should be direct cause of `AssertionError` from `raises` context manager on failure for exception to match pattern rather than context
Fix: is_fully_escaped does not handle consecutive backslashes correctly
`--strict-markers` / `--strict-config` via `addopts` silently stopped working (pytest 9 regression)
Deprecate pastebin plugin
approx with timedelta: rel parameter treated as absolute tolerance despite its name
mark expression scanner: backslash check in string literal searches entire input instead of the string value
bin_xml_escape: supplementary plane characters (U+10000+) incorrectly escaped due to wrong unicode escape in regex
Code.getargs: CO_VARARGS/CO_VARKEYWORDS bit flags treated as counts, local vars leak into argument list
Support generic mapping in builtin assertrepr compare
Fixture override order should be determined by visibility?
pytest 9.1.0: conftest.py `addoption` regressed in nested directories
assertion diff: trailing character skip fails when first characters differ (off-by-one in `left[-i]` when `i=0`)
Error collecting tests on 9.1.1 - fixtures not found when a parent directory appears multiple times in a argument list
pytest.toml without section header leads to silently ignored options
`--no-summary` disables the `pytest_terminal_summary` hook, silencing third-party plugins as well as pytest's own summary
_getini_ini: "string" type returns list silently instead of raising TypeError
(Windows) passing a file path collects the whole suite, on a network drive where st_ino is 0
MonkeyPatch records stale undo entries when delattr/setitem/delitem fails
`max_warnings` rejects the integer shown in the native TOML documentation
Spurious comma in `parametrize` causes obfuscated crash
cache.set() raises on write and close errors instead of warning
fixtures: `--fixtures-per-test` has an off-by-one on item's lineno
Native TOML numeric faulthandler_timeout is rejected
tmp_path / tmp_path_factory.mktemp list the whole basetemp on every call: O(N^2) over a session
TOML config opts `verbosity_assertions`, `verbosity_subtests`, & `verbosity_test_cases` no longer accept numeric string values in 9.2.0
